thread:
maria: FYI multiple customer reports of 502/504s hitting hosted inference since ~09:10 UTC during a big embeddings job. Seen across us-east and eu-west.

alex: seeing same in dashboards — ingress 5xx spike aligned with a big batch embed job from tenant t-847.

jamie: any recent deploys to edge/proxy?

devon: rolled a small envoy filter change at 08:58 to tweak buffer_timeouts (attempt to reduce client stalls). Could be related.

maria: repro steps from support ticket: send 10k embed requests in parallel (batch size 2048), streaming set to false. Client sees 504 after ~15s, sometimes 502.

alex: quick check: midproxy connection pool depth saturating, logs show repeated `UPSTREAM_HTTP2_STREAM_RESET` and `ENVOY_NO_HEALTHY_UPSTREAM`.

sre-bot: Alert: edge-gateway 5xx rate > 300/min for last 6m (rule: edge.gateway.5xx.rate).

jamie: can we throttle that customer or ask them to reduce parallelism? We should also roll back the envoy filter if it's the culprit.

support-ops: I DM'd the customer with a temporary throttle suggestion and requested exact request payloads & retry strategy. they confirmed exponential backoff not enabled.

devon: pulling envoy filter diff now. The change lowered per-stream data timeout threshold from 20s -> 10s. That could produce premature 504s on longer tail requests.

alex: logs from ingress show `connection_pool_exhausted` on midproxy nodes + `buffer overflow` on ingress-nginx in a few clusters. Sequence: client -> frontdoor -> midproxy -> model-hosts. midproxy pools maxed first.

maria: mitigation idea: 1) re-enable old envoy filter (rollback), 2) patch midproxy to increase upstream connection pool + backlog, 3) apply temporary WAF throttle rule to tenant t-847. Which do we want first?

jamie: rollback envoy filter now — should be fastest. Devon, can you push rollback to canary?

devon: pushing rollback to canary (canary-edge-3). Patch id: revert/envoy-buffer-2026-03-18.

sre-bot: Deploy event: revert/envoy-buffer-2026-03-18 started on canary-edge-3 at 09:28 UTC.

alex: midproxy pool adjustment as follow-up. I'll prepare a hotpatch to increase `max_connections` from 1000 -> 2000 on affected midproxy ASGs; that requires a graceful reload.

support-ops: customer accepted temporary throttle (reduced concurrency by 10x) and will retry after 15m.

maria: noticing error rates dropping on canary where rollback landed. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/edge/5xx?from=09:00&to=10:00

sre-bot: Alert cleared: edge-gateway 5xx rate below threshold.

jamie: good. Alex proceed with midproxy pool increase and notify infra on graceful reload window. Also add a short-term auto-throttle rule for very large embed batches (policy: if requests/sec from tenant > 200 and avg tokens/request > 10000 -> cap concurrency).

alex: will raise infra change and add feature flag for auto-throttle.

devon: rolling rollback to prod now (revert/envoy-buffer-2026-03-18 -> prod). ETA ~7m.

sre-bot: Deploy event: revert/envoy-buffer-2026-03-18 deployed to prod at 09:36 UTC.

maria: prod metrics show 5xxs falling back to baseline over last 10m. Customer reports improved success rate.

support-ops: ticket updated with root cause: premature buffer timeout in envoy filter causing upstream resets when clients flooded midproxy pools. Recommended customer retry/backoff & our throttles.

devon: follow-ups: 1) add test for long-running embed requests to CI (simulate 10k parallel small batches), 2) instrument midproxy pool metrics more granularly, 3) add canary guard for filter changes that touch timeouts. I'll create JIRA.

jamie: please include postmortem blameless write-up + timeline. Also check billing impact for affected tenants.

maria: assigning actions -> devon: rollback+CI test+canary guard, alex: midproxy pool scale patch + auto-throttle, support-ops: customer comms + ticket closure, jamie: PM owner for postmortem.

support-ops: confirmed ticket status set to `escalated -> mitigated`, awaiting postmortem.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll monitor for the next 2 hours and re-open if anything recurs.

alex: grabbing traces for t-847: trace ids sample: trace-0a1b2c3d, trace-4e5f6a7b. Pushing to S3: s3://redwood-support/traces/6288876543/

devon: JIRA created INF-2234 "Envoy buffer-timeout regressions for large embed bursts" with planned tasks.

jamie: adding postmortem owners and scheduled 30m follow-up sync at 14:00 UTC.

maria: closing thread for now.
